name: Yawgmoth's Vile Offering
oracle_text:
(You may cast a legendary sorcery only if you control a legendary creature or planeswalker.)
Put up to one target creature or planeswalker card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. Destroy up to one target creature or planeswalker. Exile Yawgmoth's Vile Offering.
blocked_sentences: (You may cast a legendary sorcery only if you control a legendary creature or planeswalker.)

needs.what: rule 205.4e casting restriction: a spell with both the Legendary supertype and the Sorcery type (and likewise a legendary instant) may be cast only if its caster controls a legendary creature or a legendary planeswalker; the engine's cast-legality check must read the card's supertypes and refuse the cast otherwise
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The engine reads Legendary only for the legend rule (sba.py) and deck construction (registry.py); nothing in casting checks it, so supertypes: ["Legendary"] on a sorcery is inert and the card would be castable with no legend in play. cast_only_during and condition-gated card riders only cover timing; there is no card-level cast condition key that could express the restriction by hand. The rest of the card (return_from_graveyard with an optional any_types Creature/Planeswalker card_in_graveyard target, destroy with an optional permanent target, exiles_itself) is expressible once this lands.
